sequential_registration.final_MILKR_equivalence: same final support and features imply same final refit; intermediate metrics and cumulative cost differ
sequential_registration.MoPC_larger_sessions: session20/session10 are explicit extensions, never secretly subdivide; 20 epochs per actual session
sequential_registration.external_methods: native state inheritance, no per-session reset disguised as continual learning
sequential_registration.data_condition: all eight fixed mixed datasets; single-scene analysis separate

statistics.primary_unit: model seed after averaging over 8 datasets x 7 RX x 5 draws within K/N
statistics.failure_policy: retain all failures and missing rows, never silently drop

execution.stop_rule: systemic technical/protocol/input/output/nonfinite failure stops new dispatch; preserve healthy workers; no score-based stopping

code_inventory_note: file existence, AST parse, and references only; no algorithm imported, no runtime or GPU test, no query or source IQ loaded

source_before_target_policy.A: frozen per-query evaluation only; no update or selection
source_before_target_policy.B: current-row old labeled target support; source replay only where explicitly allowed
source_before_target_policy.C: new labeled support first becomes available; joint all-registered query inference
source_before_target_policy.native_UDA_joint_training: source-only initialization S, source-target terms activated at B only
source_before_target_policy.independent_benchmark_builder: may prepare target capsule; source trainer cannot consume IQ, statistics or scores
